title: DashboardLayoutPatchPayload
description: The `layout` of a dashboard PATCH (HEL-1071): any non-empty subset of the four breakpoints (lg 12 columns, md 10, sm 6, xs 2). A breakpoint that is absent is preserved as stored; one that is identical to the stored breakpoint (same multiset of panelId/x/y/w/h, any order) passes untouched; one that differs MUST be valid (x>=0, y>=0, w>=1, h>=1, x+w<=columns, no two items overlapping) or the whole write is rejected with 400 naming the breakpoint and panel ids and nothing is saved. The server never clamps or reflows a supplied breakpoint.
